scope.meaning: Reviewed source-native lookup route behavior and direct actual API/React consumers only

intentionalAdaptations: Source GET lookups map to resource-named authenticated POST JSON APIs and the supplied React consumers.

Strict transport/body validation, current operator/session checks and bounded reference lookups implement requested hardening; source valid-result semantics retain native collation, secondary-vs-standard status and postal/title/precision behavior.
limitations: Only the two source lookup routes are admitted; no complete store/barcode template or identity-provider certification.
Generic source ASGI/session-provider and deployed reader/data acceptance remain separate requirements.
